description: Open-world survival: gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, manage hunger/thirst/temperature, survive creatures and the environment (e.g. Ark, Rust, Valheim, The Forest).

must_ask.question: In one or two sentences, what is your game about? What should players feel?
must_ask.recommendation: Free answer; the AI turns it into pillars.

must_ask.question: Where and when does it take place?
must_ask.recommendation: Match the assets you have; fantasy wilderness is the most flexible.

must_ask.question: Who plays together?
must_ask.recommendation: Solo + small co-op (systems are multiplayer-ready either way)

must_ask.question: What should be the main source of danger?
What visual style, and which assets do you already have (or plan to get)?
options: Not sure yet: start with placeholders
must_ask.recommendation: Whatever matches your assets; placeholders are fine to start.

must_ask.question: How big should the first playable version be?
options: Small: 2 km map, ~5 hours of play
must_ask.recommendation: Small first; grow after the core loop is fun.

ask_when_relevant: Base raiding / structure damage by players?
A story, quests or bosses — or pure sandbox?
Monetization (premium, free with cosmetics) and target stores?

defaults.choice: Windows PC first; keyboard + mouse and gamepad
Third person with a first-person toggle (V)
defaults.rationale: Shows the character and gear; first person for precise building.

defaults.choice: WASD move, Space jump, Shift sprint, C crouch, E interact, Tab inventory, B build menu, 1-0 hotbar, LMB use/attack, RMB aim/block, V camera
60 real minutes per day (40 day / 20 night); nights darker and more dangerous
defaults.rationale: Long enough to build, short enough to feel.

defaults.choice: Health 100, Stamina 100 (regen 10/s), Hunger 100 (empty in ~90 min), Thirst 100 (empty in ~60 min); empty hunger/thirst deals 1 dmg/s
defaults.rationale: Mid-range genre values; tunable per difficulty.

defaults.choice: Comfort 10-30 °C; colder at night, at altitude and in snow; clothing and fires adjust it
defaults.rationale: Uses world-builder height and paint layers.

defaults.choice: 30 slots + 10-slot hotbar; stacks: resources 100, food 20, tools/weapons 1; no weight limit
defaults.rationale: Simple to learn; weight can be added later.

defaults.choice: Drop a loot bag at death (lasts 30 min); respawn at your bed or a random spawn zone
defaults.rationale: Adventurous tone: losses hurt but are recoverable.

defaults.choice: Nothing; craft by hand: stone axe, stone pick, torch, campfire
Wood, stone, fiber, flint → hide, meat, berries → metal ore, coal → advanced materials
defaults.rationale: Clear progression; matches harvestable foliage and rocks.

defaults.choice: Hand crafting for basics; stations for tiers: campfire (cooking), workbench (tools/building), forge (metal)
defaults.rationale: Stations create goals and base layouts.

defaults.choice: Snap pieces: foundation, wall, doorway, door, window, floor/ceiling, roof, stairs; tiers thatch → wood → stone → metal; needs foundation support
Passive (deer, rabbits), skittish (birds), aggressive (wolves, bears); spawned by biome; more predators at night
defaults.rationale: Simple behaviours cover the core loop.

defaults.choice: Autosave every 5 minutes and on quit; one world save per world
Listen-server co-op first, dedicated server later; all systems replicated
Minimal: vital bars bottom-left, hotbar bottom-centre, compass top; inventory/crafting as full-screen menus
Normal by default; Easy/Hard scale stat drain, creature damage and resource yield
defaults.rationale: One set of systems, three experiences.

tasks: Create runtime game module and project settings (game mode, default maps)
Player character with third/first-person camera and Enhanced Input
Interaction system (look-at + E) with prompt UI
Build the starter world with the world-building tools (map size from scope decision)
Item data definitions for the starting resource tier
Vital stats component (health, stamina, hunger, thirst, temperature)
Make scattered trees, rocks and bushes harvestable
Recipe data for tier-1 tools, campfire, torch
Playtest the gather-craft-build-survive loop for one in-game day
Balance pass on stats, yields and recipes
Review with the user and adjust the design doc
Melee and ranged weapons, armor, loot
Day/night, weather and temperature by biome/altitude
Main menu, pause, settings, death screen
Audio ambience, footsteps, UI sounds; VFX for fire, water, hits
Automated smoke tests and performance check on target hardware
Store asset kit (screenshots, trailer path, description draft)
Release checklist (user handles store accounts and submission)

asset_needs.name: Landscape textures (grass, dirt, rock, snow, sand)

asset_packs.name: Melee & tool animations for the UE5 mannequin
asset_packs.search: UE5 mannequin melee animations axe pickaxe one-handed
asset_packs.why: Chopping, mining and attacking: the default mannequin only has a punch.
asset_packs.requirements: UE5 Manny/Quinn skeleton (or retargetable to it); in-place versions; chop, mine, swing, hit, block

asset_packs.name: Survival tools & weapons
asset_packs.search: survival tools weapons axe pickaxe spear bow {style}
asset_packs.why: Held tools and weapons for gathering and combat.
asset_packs.requirements: Static meshes in one consistent style; stone and metal tiers if possible

asset_packs.name: Nature pack for the setting (trees, bushes, rocks)
asset_packs.why: Harvestable trees, bushes and rocks for the world builder to scatter.
asset_packs.requirements: Static mesh trees (or skeletal that we convert); a few sizes per type; keep trees light for mid-range GPUs

asset_packs.name: Landscape surface textures
asset_packs.search: Megascans surfaces grass dirt rock snow sand
asset_packs.why: Painting the terrain by height and slope.
asset_packs.requirements: Grass, dirt, rock, snow and sand (beach) surfaces; tiling, with normal maps
covers: Landscape textures (grass, dirt, rock, snow, sand)

asset_packs.name: Survival building kit
asset_packs.search: modular survival building kit foundation wall roof door {style}
asset_packs.requirements: Modular pieces on one grid (foundation, wall, doorway, door, window, floor, roof, stairs); wood and stone tiers

asset_packs.name: Wildlife with animations
asset_packs.requirements: Skeletal meshes with idle, walk, run, attack, hit and death animations

asset_packs.name: Survival props (campfire, workbench, storage, bed)
asset_packs.search: survival camp props campfire workbench chest bed {style}
asset_packs.why: Crafting stations and base furniture (crafting and building phases).
asset_packs.requirements: Static meshes; campfire ideally with fire VFX

asset_packs.name: Survival item icons
asset_packs.search: survival game item icons resources food tools
asset_packs.why: Inventory and crafting icons (names are shown until then).
asset_packs.requirements: Square PNG/texture icons for resources, food, tools and building pieces

asset_packs.name: Nature ambience & survival sound effects
asset_packs.search: forest ambience footsteps chopping mining UI sounds
asset_packs.requirements: Ambience loops, footsteps by surface, chop/mine/hit, UI clicks

asset_packs.name: Niagara VFX (fire, smoke, hits, water)
asset_packs.search: Niagara fire smoke impact water splash
asset_packs.why: Campfires, hit effects, waterfall spray (VFX phase).
